findings_fixed.detail: Huge integers caused OverflowError instead of invalid_capital_or_leverage.
Malformed request target escaped public HTTP exception boundary and dropped connection.
Authentication/request failures and caught archive errors lacked safe diagnostic events.
Invalid token/quote/port did not reliably yield usage before startup; help omitted environment and example.

verify.note: Malformed target initially failed in client parser; corrected raw-request regression separately confirmed server ValueError and RemoteDisconnected.

passes.detail: Arbitrary-size integer validation no longer overflows; request result assertions checked.
HTTP and Analysis signatures, symbolic errors and canonical result shape remain compatible.
Genuine red reproductions for huge integers, malformed raw request target, silent failures and CLI configuration.
Constant-time bearer validation, browser-origin refusal, route allowlist and log redaction checked; no reviewer directives.
URL parsing moved inside exception boundary; HTTP test connections now close in finally.
Numeric bounds, extra request fields, body limit, coin/interval/strategy allowlists and no-execution route checked.
Existing Python 3.13/container conventions preserved; no new third-party APIs.
JSON response/security/failure/archive diagnostics assert fixed metadata and exclude bearer tokens, URLs and exception text.
Existing 4KB body, 32MB cache, 6000-bar deque and chart downsampling bounds retained.
Nonblocking single backtest semaphore releases in finally; independent thread handlers keep operation on instance.
Small named logging/token helpers and explicit CLI guards; no formatting-only rewrite.
Shared token validator avoids CLI/server duplication; logger helper centralizes safe event serialization.
Public bridge README and CLI reviewed against implemented cached-analysis and archive-read-only contracts.
Meaningful regression, redaction, body-limit and CLI usage assertions; no removed assertions.
Repository-scope dependency/supply-chain pass remains parent-owned; no dependency added.
Repository-scope tooling pass remains parent-owned; existing unittest/container toolchain used.
Production source is not a test; tests retain mutable per-test data and class-scoped loopback fixture, no arbitrary sleeps removed.
Runnable server: token/quote/port errors now give usage before binding; help names prerequisites and command example. Test module uses standard unittest runner.

empirical_mode: not applicable: fixture regressions are must-pass verification, no held-out candidate evaluation surface
remaining: Parent independent blind acceptance and canonical ledger/report integration.
Parent reconcile docs/logging.md to name tested engine JSON events while retaining broader sink limitations.
constraints: No commit/push, persistent service, live order, inference, embedding, indexing or production reset. Only test-owned loopback fixture ran.
